verdict.rationale: Cost controls are a fair question for a managed ClickHouse service, but the evidence documents no spending budgets, credit-based resource monitors, query cost or time caps, or auto-suspend of idle compute. The SQL alert rules with webhook destinations, manual pause and cancel on batch jobs, compute resizing, and CPU and memory dashboards only notify, observe, or need a human to act. None of them automatically stops a runaway query or idle compute, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.
